TRACK, MAP & IMPROVE EVERY RUN

results.description:
Map routes with your finger and Footpath will snap to roads and trails. Measure distances and elevations in seconds, then navigate along with turn-by-turn directions.

Footpath is the ultimate companion for planning and navigating custom routes. 

Join millions of adventurers and plan out your perfect route. 


SNAP TO MAP
Quickly measure distances by tracing a map with your finger or Apple Pencil. Footpath will snap to roads and trails on the map.

MEASURE DISTANCE AND ELEVATION
Know exactly how far and how high you'll travel with elevation profiles. Plan routes that match your goals.

SAVE ROUTES FOR LATER
Plan out your week or trip. Keep up to 5 routes on hand for reference, or save unlimited routes with Footpath Elite.

SHARE ROUTES
Send your routes to friends or workout partners to open on their device.


Footpath is designed to work for pretty much any activity or adventure, in any country:
• Running
• Cycling and mountain biking
• Hiking and mountaineering
• Walking
• Motorcycling and driving
• Backcountry skiing
• Kayaking and standup paddleboarding
• Sailing
• And many more!


FOOTPATH ELITE
Ready to go the extra mile? Upgrading to Footpath Elite unlocks the following powerful features:


TURN-BY-TURN NAVIGATION
- Footpath will tell you when to turn with turn-by-turn audio cues on your iPhone and Apple Watch
- Save your route and cues in advance for voice guidance that works completely offline
- Double tap your AirPods or use the playback controls button on your headphones to replay your next cue

PREMIUM OFFLINE MAPS
- 3D and topographic maps including Footpath Outdoors (Worldwide), USGS Topo Maps (U.S. and Canada), OpenCycleMap (Worldwide), and many more
- Cycling lanes, avalanche slope shading, and elevation contour lines
- Download maps for use offline
- Save places as favorites to customize your maps

ORGANIZE
- Create and edit unlimited saved routes
- Duplicate, merge, and split routes
- Organize and sort routes into custom lists

ANALYZE
- Record GPS tracks of your activities
- Use HealthKit display and log extra health and fitness metrics such as heart rate during a GPS activity
- View a calendar log and weekly summary of your activities
- Analyze splits, speed, elevation, and heart rate
- View a heatmap of your speed during your activity

EXPORT
- GPX import and export
- TCX and FIT course export for turn-by-turn navigation on Garmin and Wahoo GPS devices
- Export cue sheets to a spreadsheet app for customization and printing
- Export your routes and workouts to Apple Health


You can purchase a Footpath Elite monthly or yearly subscription through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renew can be turned off anytime by going to the Manage Subscriptions page in settings after purchase, and your features will remain active until the end of the subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the same cost as your original purchase.


TIPS FOR MAPPING ROUTES
• For longer routes, try zooming in and mapping your route in multiple segments.
• Tap and hold the map to quickly route between waypoints and POIs.
• Did Footpath snap to the wrong roads? Trace over the incorrect segment to edit, or use the eraser tool.
• Turn off snap to roads (magnet icon) and zoom in to manually trace the map. (Try switching to a satellite layer).
• Displaying maps and continuously running GPS in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. Navigate without maps or with the screen off for all day battery life.


CONTACT US
We've got a lot planned for Footpath. If you have any suggestions or feedback, or if you run into any issues, please contact us at support@footpathapp.com


Terms of Service: https://footpathapp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://footpathapp.com/privacy

Pacekeeper measures how far you walk or run, and keeps every step of it on your phone.

No account. No sign-up. No servers. Your routes are yours, and they never leave the device unless you choose to export them.

WHAT IT DOES

Distance, time, pace and speed, updated every second while you move.
Keeps counting with the screen off and the phone in your pocket.
Pauses itself when you stop at a crossing, and picks up again when you move.
Speaks your time and pace at every mile or kilometre, ducking your music rather than stopping it.
Saves each session with its route, its splits and the climb.
Exports any session as a GPX file for Strava, Garmin Connect, Komoot or anything else that reads one.
Works with no signal at all. A run in a valley with no bars is measured exactly the same as one in town.

FREE, AND STAYING FREE

Tracking. History. The route map. Splits. Elevation gain. GPX export. The voice at every mile. One profile.

Those are the things every other tracker gives away, so Pacekeeper does too.

ONE PAYMENT, NOT A SUBSCRIPTION

results.description:
Something hurts, and every other running app will still cheerfully hand you a tempo session.

ZeeRun asks where it hurts, how bad it is, and whether it gets worse or better as you run — then tells you whether to run, modify or stop, and what it takes to get back.

THE NIGGLE ROOM
Tap the spot on an anatomical body map: shin, calf, achilles, knee, hip, foot, hamstring, groin, IT band, back — each side tracked separately, so a left achilles and a right knee are two different stories. Then answer three quick questions. Get a plain-language run, modify or stop verdict, with the reason behind it and the red flags that mean see a clinician, not an app.

Anything worse than a watch-list ache opens a return-to-run ladder: four rungs from walk-jog back to a full session, each with a pass condition you clear before the next unlocks. The ladder is free, and your plan must respect the rung you are on — it cannot serve you a tempo on rung one.

THE MORNING READ
Four taps each morning become one readiness score, pulled from your sleep, HRV and resting heart rate against your own baseline through Apple Health. That score sets today's session and the week's mileage ceiling before you lace up. Ask Siri for it without opening the app.

YOUR DURABILITY
A durability score built from your injury history sets a weekly mileage ceiling and names the sites most worth watching. Load ratio and repair reading compare your last 7 days against the 4-week base you have truly adapted to, so ambition doesn't outrun adaptation. The strength work it keeps naming is now a guided prehab routine built around your own weak points.

THE RUNNING
Live pace, mile splits, saved routes, a Home Screen widget and a Live Activity. Intervals are called rep by rep in your ear, and every rep is saved as its own split. A cadence read draws your stride against your own average, never a magic number, with an optional metronome. A weather card reads heat, humidity, wind, air quality and daylight into one run-safety verdict, with what to wear.

SHOES AND FUEL
Give each pair a job — daily, tempo, long, race or trail — and ZeeRun puts the right shoe forward, retires it on the mileage that job deserves, and shows how your last four weeks split across the rotation. Long runs and races get a fuelling timeline: what to take and when, scaled to the heat.

COACH Z
An on-device coach voice writes your morning brief, your weekly debrief, and the Sunday Edition — a shareable newspaper front page of your running week — explaining every verdict without hype or noise.

Nothing about your training leaves the phone. No account, no cloud, no ads reading your health data. ZeeRun is a wellness tool built to help you train longer by training smarter, not a medical service — for medical concerns, see a professional.

FREE FOREVER
The daily check-in, today's read, Coach Z's verdict, the body map, the niggle verdict, the return-to-run ladder, Siri, shoe rotation, fuelling, prehab, and all your logging — runs, routes, shoes, records, races and Mind tools. No account, no card.

ZEERUN PRO SUBSCRIPTION
Pro unlocks the case timeline and every past case at a site, the full Body deck, adaptive race blocks and goal paces that reshape around illness, travel and an open case, the weekly debrief, the Sunday Edition and the full report.

- ZeeRun Pro Monthly — 1 month, USD 9.99 per month
- ZeeRun Pro Annual — 12 months, USD 59.99 per year

Features

Fast and Simple
• Instantly log sets with minimal taps, saving time and keeping you focused on your workout.
• Record supersets, circuits, and multisets together, so grouped movements stay fast to log.
• Rest timers start automatically after recording a set and are accessible from your Lock Screen or Dynamic Island.

Personalized Workout Plans
• Choose your primary focus: achieve a specific look with aesthetic goals or optimize performance for a sport or activity.

• For performance goals, focus on improving strength, endurance, and power to excel in your chosen sport or activity.

Powerful Organization
• Group exercises by Workout, Muscle Group, Program, Day of Week, and more with flexible lists.
• Color-code your lists and exercises with Custom Colors to find what you need at a glance.
• Add detailed notes to your exercises and lists for tracking targets and goals.
• Assign exercises to multiple lists for quick access to their history.
• Customize exercise sorting by Recent Completion, Alphabetical Order, or Manually.

Advanced Customization
• Tailor sessions with details like calories, incline level, and sport-specific metrics.
• Log every set or focus on personal records. It’s up to you.
• Choose your preferred formula for calculating one-rep max (1RM).

Analytics for Every Exercise
• Compare progress with real-time session metrics, including reps, weight/rep, volume, and sets.
• Explore dynamic graphs that showcase your progress over time.
• Filter set history by weight or rep range for deeper analysis.
• Instantly estimate your maximum potential using 1RM Percentage Tables.

Stay Motivated and Consistent
• Track your workout consistency with a visual calendar.
• Set personalized workout reminders to keep you on track.
• Stay inspired with progress graphs and actionable insights.

Apple Watch + Health Integration

Unlock unlimited access with a Pro Membership. A Lifetime Pro Membership can be purchased once without a subscription. A Pro Membership is also available with a monthly or yearly subscription. results.description:
RaceJoy is created specifically for running, cycling and triathlon events with a focus on the participant and spectator experience. Features vary by event and include live phone tracking, progress alerts, results, race information, photos, Send-a-Cheer and much more!

There are two distinct experiences in RaceJoy:
-Featured Events
-Training Days

Featured Events (shown with the Event Logo):
These are events that have contracted with RaceJoy to provide a premium experience for participants and spectators. Features are free and provided by the event or sponsor(s).

Features included:
-Live GPS, phone tracking on the course map.
-Send-a-Cheer! (fun motivational audio clips).
-NearMe alerts (spectators and waiting relay teams get an alert when a participant is drawing near).
-MeetUp tool for seeing where you are in relation to a participant.
-Automatic Progress Postings to Twitter (with your approval, of course!).

The following features may be provided by the event:
-Scored Race Results within moments of crossing the finish line.
-Essential race information like schedules, FAQs, race news, and more.
-Your official race photos.
-Optional Tracking with Progress Alerts: Some events offer BIBTAG tracking in addition to PhoneTrak.  For these events there is no need to carry your phone as this is based on the participant’s BIB/chip as they cross over timing points on the course.

Training Days
This area enables athletes to have their friends and family track their progress live on a map and send motivational cheers during long training runs or rides. All PhoneTrak features are available in Training Days, along with special motivational cheers to help you through those tough moments. Training Days is a free always available area for your long training days.  Based on our privacy policy you must setup a special tracking ID (PIN) with profile name and provide that to friends and family tracking you on your Training Days.

Add a Race?
If you would like a race to offer the full featured experience with official race progress alerts and results, please let the race director know about RaceJoy.

Battery Usage
RaceJoy’s live phone tracking feature is ONLY activated during the hours of the event. When using Training Days, the athlete turns on/off tracking as needed. Use of this GPS technology running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. You may disable this under settings at anytime during the event to conserve battery life if needed.

Feedback and Support
We hope you enjoy using RaceJoy! Please share your experience in the App store to encourage others to try it out. If you have had any issues, or have feedback or ideas, please help us to improve the experience by contacting us at support@racejoy.com.

RaceJoy is created by a small family business and is dedicated to changing the race experience.

Easily set up and record your Interval and Fartlek running sessions. With the flexibility of using time and/or distance as interval targets for your "Hard", "Easy" and "Rest" efforts. The simple but highly configurable interface on your phone and watch will have you running sooner.

Now with a Distance Goal option for your session. Along with great audio and visual feedback, detailed post-run summary, share your runs to Strava, and a full-featured Apple Watch app.

You can also record your regular runs with voice-over calling out distance and pace feedback.

Key Features:
• Easily create flexible custom interval sessions.
• Utilize three effort targets "Hard", "Easy" and "Rest" in each set, targeting time or distance (meters or miles).
• You can "Skip" any of the three efforts to create flexible sets, like building a progressive intervals session.
• NEW: Set a Distance Goal for your session, that repeats the sets from the start until the distance has been reached.
• Set a Warm-Up and Warm-Down timer or distance around your session.
• Clear and easily glanceable visuals and audio prompts, including vibrations.
• Voice-over prompts to save you from looking at the screen, great for iPhone or headphone users.
• Voice-over prompts include the upcoming intervals effort and time/distance amount, and your last intervals average pace and heart rate.
• Full-featured Apple Watch App!
• Heart Rate Zones! (see description below)
• Indoor Mode, no GPS, for treadmill running.
• Sound Mode, for normal, discrete or silent audio prompts on your watch.
• Vibration feedback on both the phone and watch.
• Detailed run summary, showing pace for hard and easy efforts.
• The run summary also includes interval breakdown, distance breakdown and heart rate details.
• Play music or podcasts while running and still hear the audio prompts.
• Sharing. Share a summary photo with your friends.
• Private data. We don’t send any of your data to a server or share it with anyone.

Session Types:
• Normal Run – Record a normal run, long or short.
• Record Intervals – If you run with a group or do an undefined session, then use the Record Interval option. It allows you to manually change between "Hard" and "Easy" reps, allowing you to record your session.
• Custom Intervals – Our fully flexible intervals that allow you to use time and/or distance for the efforts. Add multiple intervals sets together to create the session you want.

Sharing:
From the summary screen, you can share your runs with friends or across social media. If you want to share directly with friends or across other social media, you can share a summary image with the details of your run.

Heart Rate Zones: (Apple Watch Only)
Zones are displayed as grouped percentages of your maximum heart rate. Giving you an indication of your current work rate based on your current heart rate. Just enter your maximum workout heart rate into our Settings screen and they will display on your Watch the next time you run.
Zone 1: Very Light Effort 50-60% (Gray)
Zone 2: Light Effort 60-70% (Blue)
Zone 3: Moderate Effort 70-80% (Green)
Zone 4: Hard Effort 80-90% (Yellow)
Zone 5: Maximum Effort 90-100% (Red)

Privacy:
We don’t want to know where you have run, that's for you to worry about. We don’t send any of your data to a server or share it with anyone you don't want too. We keep your running records safe in Apple Health so you have control. Apple Heath gives you the control over who accesses your data. We only write and read the data we record from your running.

Feedback:
And because we don't send any data to a server, we need you to send us feedback and suggestions. Hit the Support link below or visit our website to contact us.

results.description:
INTVL: The World Is the Game.

INTVL turns every walk, run or bike ride into a game played on the real world globe. The idea is simple. When you run or ride in a loop, the ground inside that loop becomes your territory. The bigger, smarter and more tactical your routes, the more of the map you hold.

Claim your territory

Every loop you complete claims real space. Other players are out there doing the same thing, so the map is always moving. You can take a new route to take new ground, or go back over an area to defend what's already yours.

Play it your way

Some people want to be the best in the world, so they chase the global leaderboard. Others care more about home turf and work to become the territory leader of their own suburb or city. Both are worth playing for, and you can switch focus whenever you want.

Hold ground, win real prizes

Every bit of the map you hold earns you entries into our competitions, where the prizes are real. The more territory you hold at the end of the competition, the better your odds.

Run and ride with clubs

Join a club and play as a team. Your territory adds to your club's total, so a good capture from you helps everyone you're playing alongside.

A feed built around the game

INTVL has a social feed where you can follow other players, see their activities, and cheer them on. It's a good way to find people around you and stay connected to other athletes around the world.

Bring your own gear

INTVL works with the devices you already train on, so your activities sync straight into the game:
- Garmin
- Suunto
- Polar
- Coros
- Fitbit
- Hammerhead
- Wahoo

We built INTVL to give a new meaning to fitness. Movement without stakes is just exercise. The world is the game. Take it.

This app integrates with Apple Health (HealthKit) to show insights about your activity, including steps, heart rate, and previous runs.

Privacy Policy: https://www.intvl.com.au/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

results.description:
Forrest is an innovative fitness tracking app designed for iOS users who want to add a fun and challenging twist to their running and cycling workouts. Forrest gives your usual workouts a new competitive dimension. Your runs and rides are no longer solitary endeavours, but exhilarating races against virtual opponents (ghost racers) or your personal bests and previous races. In the latest Version 2.0, we’ve amplified the excitement by enabling you to challenge your friends wherever they are in the world, infusing social connectivity into every stride. The purpose built race screen provides real-time insights into your position during the race, while audio prompts keep you focused on your goal even when your iPhone is locked, empowering you to fully embrace the race, whether you’re on foot or two wheels.
It turns your runs and rides into races by giving you someone to compete against.

Here's how it works:

1. Choose from a variety of preloaded race options or craft your own custom race event according to your preferences.

2. Add virtual opponents in the form of ghost-racers that'll run or ride at a speed you choose.

3. Add your personal best times or previous race results to race against yourself.

4. Add your friends. Take the challenge to the next level by racing against your friends wherever they are in the world.

5. Race!

6. Hear audio prompts on your race progress while you run or ride:
	• "You've overtaken your personal best to take 1st place."
	• "That's 30 minutes. You've completed 5.3km." 
	• "Your target ghost racer is 12 seconds ahead of you in 2nd place."

7. Win! Get faster and fitter.

8. Review your race with maps, graphs, and export to Strava or Apple Health.

9. Share your achievements on social media with integrated social sharing.

Forrest for Apple Watch gives you the freedom to race without your phone. Enjoy the same fun race experience from your wrist with live stats, race progress, and opponent times; hear the same audio prompts you’re used to hearing on iPhone; and listen to and control your favourite workout music.

Unlock a host of exclusive features designed to amplify your workouts and enhance your overall experience with Forrest Pro:

• Race against your friends — Embrace healthy competition by challenging your friends to races. Elevate your motivation and achieve more together.
• Expand your competition — Engage in races with up to 10 opponents, allowing you to set higher goals and experience more exhilarating races.
• Exclusive Pro profile badge — Stand out from the crowd with the exclusive Forrest Pro profile badge. Showcase your commitment to fitness and achievement.
• Ad-Free racing — Enjoy an uninterrupted workout session with an advert-free experience throughout the Forrest app. Immerse yourself in your fitness goals without distractions.
• Fresh app icons — Customise your app experience to match your personal preference with a collection of new and eye-catching home-screen app icons. Adding a touch of visual flair to your fitness journey.

Forrest Pro is more than just a subscription; it’s a gateway to a more dynamic, engaging, and personalised fitness journey. Elevate your runs and rides, compete with friends, and reap the rewards of your hard work with Forrest Pro.

Privacy Policy: https://forrest.app/privacy-policy

Tim, the developer.

IMPROVEMENTS
After the iOS 27 update, you may have been one of the unlucky ones who experienced a bumpy ride with unpredictable app loading. Hopefully, no more.

NEW
HRV Better Reflecting Your Recovery
With the new iOS, Apple introduced the RMSSD method for HRV, which now better reflects your recovery. Available on Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4.

Temperature with Baseline
On iOS 27, you can keep the current temperature view or switch to a baseline view. You can switch views in the app: Gentler Streak → Profile → Settings → Temperature.

Temperature for non-Apple Watch
If your non-Apple Watch tracker saves temperature to Apple Health, you should now see it among body metrics.

Hey, welcome the Gentler Streak - the app that keeps your active life alive! An award-winning health and fitness tracker offers personalized guidance that adapts to your daily capabilities and not the other way around. For those of us who want to move consistently, not constantly.

Built with care by a small indie team.

• 2024 Apple Design Award - Social Impact | 2022 Apple Watch App of the Year | App of the Day | Editor’s Choice
• Featured in The Verge, Forbes, TechCrunch, and more.

▶ PRIVATE DATA STAYS PRIVATE
Your health and fitness data stays on-device via Apple HealthKit, with no external processing.

▶UNDERSTAND YOUR DAILY READINESS◀
[KEY HEALTH METRICS]
Start your day with a summary of key vitals and sleep, helping you detect changes before you feel them. Receive workout suggestions that respond to your readiness. Set home screen widgets to bring this info closer to you.

[FULL SLEEP ANALYSIS]
See everything from sleep onset to how much restorative sleep you are getting. View trends over 14 nights in sleep duration, consistency, and stages to spot patterns and improve your sleep hygiene.

[DAILY STEPS, DONE DIFFERENTLY]
You can now track daily steps, distance, walking time, flights climbed, and walking heart rate—all with a 14-day trend overview.
Our approach doesn’t push you to chase step goals. Instead, it helps you understand your daily movement patterns—ideal for everyday walkers and those managing chronic conditions.

[SYNC ACTIVITIES WITH YOUR CYCLE]
Know daily stress tolerance of each menstrual cycle phase and receive support for your current state, with workout suggestions like "Flow Workouts" along with allowing you to take a pause when your period starts.

▶STAYING ACTIVE ON YOUR TERMS◀
[STREAK & STATUS]
Keep your streak alive by following your body’s needs, even when it calls for rest days. When life happens—be it illness, injury, or vacation—adjust your status to reflect real life and skip feeling guilty.

[AWARD-WINNING APPLE WATCH WORKOUT TRACKER]
Track real-time training effects and heart rate zones to manage your workout intensity and avoid overtraining. Get a countdown to “overreaching” to know exactly when you're close to pushing too hard for the day.

[PERSONALIZED WORKOUT TRACKING]
Track 140+ activities, from chores to a variety of workouts, with detailed maps and metric charts, and stay within your healthy activity levels.

[TAILORED DAILY WORKOUTS]
Get daily suggestions—ranging from rest to high-intensity exercises—based on your readiness. Go Gentler's on-watch suggestions allow you to scale your exercise duration and/or intensity up or down.

▶ULTIMATE WORKOUT JOURNAL◀
[PERSONALIZED SUMMARIES]
Turn your workout summaries into a personalized fitness journal. Customize them with details that matter to you: rename workouts, add notes, photos, and mark your favorite sessions. Plus, adjust the effort using the RPE chart when needed.

[PROGRESS CHARTS]
Your progress with weekly, monthly and yearly charts, including a weekly, monthly and yearly recap.

[LIVE ACTIVITY & WIDGETS]
Use Live Activity for tracking on iPhone, and interactive widgets on your Home & Lock screens.

[ACCESSIBLE TO ALL]
Full support for accessibility preferences including bold text, dynamic type, reduced transparency, increased contrast, motion adjustments, and voiceover.

results.description:
RunFit allows you to display your weekly progress from your running and walking workouts directly on your Apple Watch faces. It features a simple and easy to read native design, support many types of complications, automatic data refresh and more.

* YOUR WEEKLY PROGRESS

Easily keep track of three important weekly metrics:

• Distance
• Running time
• Quality time

With those metrics, you'll get an idea of how much training you did for the week. Every first day of the week, the data is reset so you can begin the new week anew.

* TRENDS

See how your last week of training stack up against your training history. If you are doing the same or better, your arrows will be up. If you aren't doing well, they will be down. Your weekly history is safely saved in iCloud so don't worry if you decide to upgrade your Apple Watch; your history will follow!

* ALWAYS ON YOUR WRIST

Each stats are available as separate complications that refresh automatically (approx. every 15 minutes). That means that by customizing your favourite watch face, you'll be able to quickly glance at your running data without even having to open the app. And now with watchOS 7, you can display all three stats on the same watch face. Make sure to keep your Apple Watch updated to the latest version to enjoy this new feature!


* QUALITY TIME

Quality time is the number of minutes during the week that were run at or faster than your quality pace. You can set your desired pace in the app. In practice, that should correspond to a pace fast enough that you feel that you're making good effort during your run.

Quality minutes are a useful tool to make sure that you are not constantly running fast and hard and are only available for running workouts.


* NOTIFICATIONS

You can choose to be notified if your quality percentage gets too high for the week. This way, you will know that it should be a good idea to run a bit slower for the rest of the week.


* SUPPORTS YOUR FAVOURITE WORKOUT APPS

You don't even need to do your workout with your Apple Watch for RunFit to work. As long as your workout data gets saved in the Health app of your iPhone you are good to go. Most popular iOS workout apps such as Strava and Garmin Connect integrates with the Health app. If you prefer to keep things simple, running workouts done with Apple Watch's built in Workout app are, of course, also supported.


* TOTAL PRIVACY

RunFit does not use user analytics and do not send any data; it literally can't as it has no server. Everything that happens on your Apple Watch stays on your Apple Watch, right there with you.


* BUILT FOR EVERYONE

Whether you just picked up running or walking as a hobby or you are an elite marathon runner, RunFit's simple and easy to read metrics will help you keep track of your weekly training.

results.description:
Milepost records your runs and walks and keeps them on your phone. Press Start, go, press Finish. That is the whole app.

WHILE YOU RUN
A full-screen recorder shows the clock, your current split pace and distance in big type you can read at a glance. Pause stops the clock, Resume picks it up, Finish saves. Lock the phone or switch apps and the recording keeps going. Collapse the recorder and the same run sits on the map with your route drawing in as you move.

SPLITS AS THEY HAPPEN
Every mile (or kilometre) rolls onto a splits bar so you can see whether this one is faster or slower than the last. Runs that cover less than a few metres are caught before they are saved, so a false start never clutters your log.

VOICE CUES
Optional spoken cues every mile or every half mile with your time and last split pace, read over your music with the screen locked.

YOUR LOG
Every activity with its route on a map, distance, time, average pace, and each split. Weekly and all-time totals on the You tab. Miles or kilometres, your choice, and each run keeps the unit it was recorded in.

FRIENDS ON THE BLOCK
The Block tab has two sides: Mine, your own log, and Friends. Sign in with Apple, pick a username, and add friends by searching for theirs. Once they accept, you see each other's activities: sport, title, distance, pace and time. Friends are optional; without an account the app works exactly the same.

YOUR ROUTES STAY ON YOUR PHONE
Recording needs no account. Runs and their routes live in a database on your phone. If you sign in for friends, only each activity's stats are shared, and only with people you accept. Maps, GPS points and splits are never uploaded. Turn sharing off or delete your account from the You tab at any time. There are no ads and no analytics. Location is asked for when you press Start and used only while a run is recording.

Milepost uses GPS, so it needs open sky; runs that start indoors show distance once you are outside and moving.

- optimizing the workout regimen;
- navigating the area you’re touring;

Picking the appropriate physical activity or vehicle type in the menu, you’ll have the experience customized to better suit your needs.

Working with FitGet boils down to several easy steps:

2. Stop the tracker once the route is complete.

ALL-PURPOSE MOBILITY TRACKER

FitGet targets anyone who takes a special interest in their courses – from tourists to athletes, from drivers to disabled people. At the moment, the app functionality covers such activities as jogging, cycling, hiking, touring, skiing, swimming, riding in a car, using a wheelchair, and more.

A VARIETY OF PARAMETERS

Depending on the activity type, the system highlights a specific set of tracked attributes that can include: 
moving speed (both average and peak), 
distance covered;
amount of steps;
tempo;
terrain characteristics (elevation range, maximum inclination angle);
physical markers (heart rate, calories burned).

FLEXIBLE VISUALISATION

For each of the monitored parameters in the given trek, the app builds a graph that shows how the readings changed over time. Graphs can be collapsed and restored to move the focus as needed. REAL TIME INSIGHTS

ROUTINES, SUPERSETS AND MERGES

APPLE WATCH

Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for your Strength Index and its recent line, your streak, the week so far, and a one-tap start for today. Ask Siri to start a routine, or how your Strength Index and training week are doing.

BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO DON'T WANT AN ACCOUNT

Run Bests finds your personal best running times in Apple Health.

Runs rarely end at exactly the same distance. Set the distances you care about and choose a margin to group comparable workouts. A 5-mile target with a 0.25-mile margin includes runs from 5.0 through 5.25 miles.

COMPARE TIMES CLEARLY
Workout time covers the full run and uses the duration reported by Health. Race time estimates how long it took to reach your target distance from the start. Both exclude pauses. Each has its own pace, and the workout detail explains which time you are viewing.

FIND YOUR FASTEST SEGMENTS
See your fastest continuous 1 mile, 1 km, or custom distance anywhere within a run. Segment estimates use Health's recorded distance samples when available, with GPS as a labeled fallback. A best segment can start between the fixed split markers shown in Fitness.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR RECORDS
Choose distances in miles or kilometers, set a distance margin, and enable half marathon, marathon, longest run, longest workout time, and fastest average pace records.

FOLLOW YOUR PROGRESS
Filter by all time, a recent period, a calendar year, or a custom date range. View the top 20 in each category and sort qualifying runs by race time, race pace, workout time, or workout pace. Workout sorts include runs without usable race timing.

EXPLORE EACH RUN
Open a workout to see its timing, distance, route map, heart rate, elevation, energy, and weather when those details are available in Health.

YOUR DATA STAYS UNDER YOUR CONTROL
Run Bests reads running workouts from Apple Health and keeps a local cache on your device. No account, advertising, tracking, or developer-operated server. Run Bests does not write to Health.

Requires running workouts in Apple Health. Race and segment estimates depend on the distance and timing data recorded with each workout.

**New in Runtime 2.3** watchOS 2, iOS 9, and 3D Touch Support!

**New in Runtime 2.2** Apple Watch and Split Times!

**New in Runtime 2.1** Shoe Tracking and HealthKit!

**New in Runtime 2.0** Stopwatch Widget, Detailed Running Statistics, Live Running Map View

Runtime is a simple run tracking app that takes advantage of the latest features in iOS 8, the iPhone 5s, and the iPhone 6. Use Runtime to track your route, time, speed, pace, and altitude everywhere you go for a run/walk/hike/jog/jaunt etc.

Runtime supports Apple Watch for controlling your run right from your wrist. Use Apple Watch to start a run, view stats on your progress while you're on the go, including pace, distance, time, location, and split times and a complete elevation profile. Runtime for Apple Watch is an incredibly advanced stopwatch right on your wrist.

You can also control your workout without the stopwatch widget. Quickly start a new run from Notification Center, pause a run without launching the app, and view your time, distance, and steps all from the convenience of the Today screen.

Keep track of the mileage on your shoes with the new Shoe Closet feature to add your shoes to Runtime and automatically log the distance you run on each shoe.

Visualize your content. Organize your routes and times into places and view rich 3D map images of each run. View pace and elevation details for each run.

Runtime supports the M7 motion co-processor, which allows you to use Runtime as a pedometer. Open the menu to view how many steps you've taken today and this week.

Runtime will also use the M7 to show you when and where you stopped to rest on the trail. Time spent walking is highlighted yellow, while normal activity is highlighted orange.

Share your workouts with friends and other apps. Runtime can export KML and GPX files that you can use with other apps. GPX files can be used for geotagging your photos, or for location simulation in Xcode!

**New in Runtime 2.0** Runtime is now FREE! Track your runs in the app and in HealthKit, start new runs with the stopwatch widget, and view a detailed map of your route, all for free.

You can also upgrade to Runtime’s Advanced Features, which include:
- Track the distance run on each of your shoes.
- Adding multiple places that you want to track workouts.
- Create custom workouts. Use the Interval Timer to configure high and low intensity alerts with custom alert tones for a rich custom workout experience!
- Use the cutting edge Flyover feature to get a cinematic tour of your tracked routes! 
- View detailed stats for every place you run to track your trends over time.

Additional features include:
- State Restoration
- Backup data with Dropbox import/export*
- Add notes to each run
- AirDrop or email your route to friends
- Share your run on Twitter and Facebook
- Deferred Location updates can help save battery power on long runs (iPhone 5 and up)

* Dropbox import/export requires a Dropbox account. Learn more about Dropbox at dropbox.com.

Disclaimer: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

Learn more about Runtime at conradstoll.com/runtime

JustRun: Your Ultimate Running Companion

JustRun is your perfect partner for tracking distance, time, and routes while you run. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned runner, JustRun provides you with all the essential tools to monitor and improve your performance.

Key Features:

Distance and Time Tracking:
Accurately measure the distance you run and keep track of the duration of your workouts. Know exactly how many miles or kilometers you've covered and how long it took you.

Average Pace Tracking:
Get real-time updates on your average pace, helping you maintain or improve your running speed.

Route Mapping:
Visualize your runs on a map. See the routes you've taken and discover new paths to explore.

Calories Burned:
Keep track of the calories you've burned during each run, helping you stay on top of your fitness and weight goals.

Run History:
Maintain a detailed history of all your runs. Review past workouts, analyze your progress over time, and set new personal records.

Whether you’re running for health, training for a race, or just enjoying the outdoors, JustRun helps you achieve your running goals with precision and ease. Download JustRun today and take your running to the next level!
